LIGHTHOUSE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1994
An Ordinance fiuther to amend the
Lighthouse Act, 1927
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 4th April, 1994]
No.F.2(1)/94-Pub., dated
4-4-1994.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(l) This Ordinance may be called
the Lighthouse (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in section 10, Act XVII of 1927

ORDINANCE XXIV OF 1994
ORDINANCE XXIV OF 1994
LIGHTHOUSE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1994
An Ordinance fiuther to amend the
Lighthouse Act, 1927
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 4th April, 1994]
No.F.2(1)/94-Pub., dated
4-4-1994.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
2. Amendment in section 10, Act XVII of 1927.--In the Lighthouse
Act, 1927 (XVII of 1927), in section 10, in subsection (1),---
(a) after the word and comma
"may,", the words and comma "from time to time," shall be
inserted; and
(b) the commas and words ",
not exceeding fifty paisa per ton," shall be omitted.
